Annotation.description: Design §18.9. Written by the Viewer and `lite-eval triage` (E3).
Annotation.title: Annotation

AnnotationRequest.description: What the page sends; the server adds the id, the author and the time (design §18.9).
AnnotationRequest.title: AnnotationRequest

BaselineChange.description:
One `lite-eval baseline set`, appended to `<root>/baselines.log.jsonl` (design §12): the
Viewer's trends mark where a suite's baseline switched.
BaselineChange.title: BaselineChange

CaseContent.description:
`current`: the dataset holds the content the run saw; `changed`: it holds other content
now (shown); `missing`: the dataset or the case is gone.
CaseContent.title: CaseContent

DatasetChange.description: The first point of a trend measured on another dataset content than the point before.
DatasetChange.title: DatasetChange

ExportPayload.description:
What `lite-eval report --html` embeds in #lite-eval-data (design §18.22). In the OpenAPI
spec as a component, so the frontend's type is generated, not written by hand.
ExportPayload.title: ExportPayload

GateRule.description: Design §8.4, §18.19: an absolute bound (`min` / `max`) or a drop against the baseline.
GateRule.title: GateRule

RunRow.description: One run as the Runs page lists it.
RunRow.title: RunRow
